description: This file contains an abstract test class for verifying dependency injection integration with Orleans grains. It includes setup for services, various test methods to check singleton and scoped dependencies, grain creation, and injection behavior, focusing on ensuring Orleans' grain lifecycle and DI features work correctly together.

classes.name: DependencyInjectionGrainTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract base class for Orleans dependency injection integration tests, providing common test methods to verify DI behavior in grain activation and injection scope.

methods.name: CanGetGrainWithInjectedDependencies
methods.description: Tests if a grain can be activated with constructor dependencies injected properly.

methods.name: CanGetGrainWithInjectedGrainFactory
methods.description: Checks if IGrainFactory can be injected and used within grains.

methods.name: CanResolveSingletonDependencies
methods.description: Verifies singleton services are shared across grain instances.

methods.name: CanResolveScopedDependencies
methods.description: Verifies that scoped services provide unique instances per grain activation.

methods.name: CanResolveScopedGrainActivationContext
methods.description: Verifies that IGrainActivationContext is available as a scoped service for each grain activation.

methods.name: ScopedDependenciesAreThreadSafe
methods.description: Ensures scoped service instances are thread-safe within a grain.

methods.name: CanResolveSameDependenciesViaServiceProvider
methods.description: Checks if services resolved directly from IServiceProvider match those injected via constructor.

methods.name: CanResolveSingletonGrainFactory
methods.description: Verifies that IGrainFactory is registered as a singleton and consistent across grains.

methods.name: CannotGetExplictlyRegisteredGrain
methods.description: Ensures that explicitly registered grains in DI are ignored by Orleans and cannot be resolved as grains.

methods.name: CanUseGenericArgumentsInConstructor
methods.description: Tests that generic grains can have dependencies injected based on their type parameters.
